descriptionHtml:
Approach · OAT-02 Encryption Verification · S08 Plain http:// at the edge and as an auth origin: refused or redirected, never served or trusted

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1 Every network request the app makes (web, iOS and Android, in Hospital and Nursing Home) uses HTTPS. There is no plain-HTTP endpoint anywhere. (UAT OAT-02; UAT 4; TFA-92568 AC 4; TFA-92568 Eng 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92568 in progress

Test design technique: Boundary values (boundary) — Sit right on the edge of the rule (exactly on time / a minute late, empty, longest, most) and see on which side the behavior changes.

Given The deployed web host and the deployment's .convex.cloud and .convex.site URLs, on the deployment Q8 names (never , never from this agent)

When Send requests with curl -I: http:// and https:// to the web host root, to <deployment>.convex.cloud and to <deployment>.convex.site/api/auth/get-session. Run openssl s_client with -tls1_1 and with -tls1_2. …

Then Plain http:// is either refused or answered only with a 301/308 to https://, with no body, no Set-Cookie and no data. https:// answers. The backend accepts only the https web origin, capacitor://localhost and https://localhost as auth origins. The accepted TLS versions and the HSTS header are recorded.

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): UAT OAT-02 step 1 'no plain HTTP endpoint anywhere'. Any http:// URL that answers 2xx with app content or API data = Fail. An http:// origin on a public host (http://qa.e2b.app, ) accepted (Access-Control-Allow-Origin echoed, or no 'invalid origin' refusal) = Fail, because a page served over plain HTTP becomes a trusted entry to the backend; …

Where it ran: dev; test method API · API (Convex functions); lane planned in the matrix: manual (manual)

S08 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/OAT-02.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: API · API (Convex functions); secondary: CODEREVIEW · Code review — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on dev; Source: dev.
